 Tip of the Day: Barnes to star with goals for both sides at St James’ Park
 Today's Tip of the Day is predicting at least two goals between Newcastle and Everton tonight
 Jon Fisher 
 • 
 Last Update:
 16 minutes ago
 • 
 2 min read
 Monday’s (somewhat belated) Tip of the Day takes us to St James’ Park for tonight’s Premier League offering.
 Newcastle and Everton met in the EFL Cup last Thursday with the Toffees emerging 3-1 winners despite spending much of the evening on the back foot.
 The Tynesiders will be desperate to claim revenge and will adopt a front-foot approach on home turf.
 That ought to mean space on the counter for an Everton side that prefers to sit deep and then burst forward.
 Newcastle’s challenge will be led by Harvey Barnes, who remains their best attacking outlet. We think there will be goals tonight and Barnes will be at the centre of the action.
 Monday’s Tip of the Day (all odds are from bet365 and correct as of 1600 on Monday, November 2) 
 Newcastle v Everton – both teams to score 
 Newcastle’s Harvey Barnes to score or assist 
 Newcastle v Everton – both teams to receive a card 
 Combined odds of 11/5
